kind: Local component and transport regressions; no hosted mutation or physical-device acceptance
verifiedBehavior: Current owner is passed for native/web saved reads and writes. Web helper subscribes before session lookup, observes identity for legacy client-only calls, pins RPC Authorization to captured JWT, rejects account round trips and unsubscribes after completion.

Synchronous bookmark locks prevent repeated dispatch before React renders. Baselines update only after exact server acknowledgement. Uncertain writes disable replay and recover through actual saved-status read.
Auth transitions, close and unmount suppress late state, selection and busy callbacks. StoryAudioEditor keeps its own in-flight selection alive when parent onBusyChange temporarily disables controls.

All valid server favorites through the 200-ID contract are retained. Saved choices reauthorize outside the first browse page with four workers and one common 20-second deadline; partial failures remain visible.
Selecting the same sound again on native/web starts a fresh authorization request and releases checking before Use/Done.
Emergency-disabled story music still avoids audio/Auth initialization.
limits: Behavior fixtures execute source components with synthetic transport; they do not prove hosted schema installation or a live account mutation.
Native favorite transport is implemented and independently tested in the frontend agent lane; this receipt hashes only the files owned by this lane.
Global strict lint is not claimed.
Licensed catalogue activation and device acceptance remain separate recorded gates.
